## Task

Perform in-depth analysis of each module/component identified in Stage 1, and generate separate component detail files.

## Execution Steps

- [Proc1.1] Confirm the target project path
- [Proc1.2] Use the aet-analyzing-project skill and route to `project-overview`
- [Proc2] Execute according to `references/phase1-project-overview.md`, and skipping steps is prohibited
- [Proc3] Use the question tool to Confirm the user's intent (continue to component analysis or end the workflow)
- [Proc4.1] Use the `step_handover` tool to explicitly hand over the work to the `component-analysis` stage or end the workflow.
- [Proc4.2] Stop

## Output

**output path**: `<projectDir>/.aet/project-analysis/` (output directly to the analysis project directory)
